reviews.author: Ja Gr
reviews.text: Had some issues at our home. Our builder sent us to Buford. Even though we were just outside the warranty window they were still nice enough to come take care of the problem for us. The guy they sent out was very professional and explained the issues and got it taken care of super fast. Great company!

reviews.author: Mike Charge
reviews.text: I was recommended to Buford and gave them a call, Chris came out the next day first thing and gave me a quote. They were available to conduct the work within a few days and showed up when they said they would. I had 2 20amp circuits added to my home and 2 single gang boxes to a room and it took them about an hour to do. When it was done I paid the same price I was quoted and would definitely recommend and use Buford Electric again in the future.
